title: A good idea
description: Charlotte makes coffee for Jane. They discuss how much milk, sugar, and other things Jane wants. The lesson covers the difference between 'a little/a few' and 'little/few', as well as comparative and superlative forms.
answer_note: Practice A (dialogue fill-in) answers are from the workbook answer key. Practice B (vocabulary) answers are suggested. Grammar answers are from the grammar practice book key.

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Shall I make some coffee, Jane?

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: It's ready. Do you want any milk?
lines.translation: 咖啡好了，你要放点奶吗？

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: What about some sugar? Two teaspoonfuls?
lines.translation: 加些糖怎么样？两茶匙行吗？

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: No, less than that. One and a half teaspoonfuls, please. That's enough for me.
lines.translation: 不，再少一些。请放一勺半。那对我已足够了。

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: I'd like a cigarette, too. May I have one?
lines.translation: 我还想抽支烟。可以给我一支吗？

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Of course. I think there are a few in that box.
lines.translation: 当然可以。我想那个盒子里有一些。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Have a biscuit instead. Eat more and smoke less!
lines.translation: 那就吃块饼干吧。多吃点儿，少抽点儿！

items.meaning: 少许（用于不可数名词之前）
几个（用于可数名词之前）

items.title: less than that
items.text: less than that，意思是'比那稍微少一些'，其中的that指上文中的two teaspoonfuls。

items.title: I'd
items.text: I'd = I would; I'd like ...，我想要……。

items.title: What a pity!
items.text: What a pity! 真遗憾。英语中常用'What a + 可数名词'和'What + 不可数名词'的结构来表示感叹。

grammar.title: Grammar II: Complete the dialogues according to the examples
grammar.instruction: Complete the dialogues according to the examples. Example: Would you like some butter? → Yes, please. I'd like some butter. I've got very little. / Would you like some milk? → No, thank you. I don't want any milk. I still have a little.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句完成下列对话。例句：你想来点黄油吗？→ 是的，请。我想要些黄油。我剩得很少了。/ 你想来点牛奶吗？→ 不，谢谢。我不想要任何牛奶。我还有一点。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 109 II, PDF p.540-541)
grammar.context: Complete each dialogue using 'a little/little' or 'a few/few' appropriately. Items 1a and 2a are printed examples.

grammar.title: Grammar IV: Make dialogues according to the example
grammar.instruction: Make dialogues according to the example. Example: I/got a good mark in the exam/John/Jane → I got a good mark in the exam. / You're right. But John got a better mark. And Jane got the best mark of all.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句编写对话。例句：I/got a good mark in the exam/John/Jane → 我在考试中得了个好分数。/ 你说得对。但John得了更好的分数。而Jane得了所有人中最好的分数。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 109 IV, PDF p.541-542)
grammar.context: Make a dialogue for each set of words using positive, comparative, and superlative forms. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: I/got a good mark in the exam/John/Jane
questions.answer: I got a good mark in the exam. / You're right. But John got a better mark. And Jane got the best mark of all.

questions.prompt: I/made very few mistakes/John/Jane
questions.answer: I made very few mistakes. / You're right. But John made fewer mistakes. And Jane made the fewest mistakes of all.

questions.prompt: that restaurant/is very bad/the Small Café/the Sun Restaurant
questions.answer: That restaurant is very bad. / You're right. But the Small Café is worse. And the Sun Restaurant is the worst of all.

questions.prompt: she/earns very little money/he/his brother
questions.answer: She earns very little money. / You're right. But he earns less money. And his brother earns the least of all.

questions.prompt: I/have a lot of friends/Jenny/Robert
questions.answer: I have a lot of friends. / You're right. But Jenny has more friends. And Robert has the most of all.

questions.prompt: Charlotte/makes good coffee/my sister/my mother
questions.answer: Charlotte makes good coffee. / You're right. But my sister makes better coffee. And my mother makes the best (coffee) of all.
